passage:
Westport Trade Fair 2026 — Exhibitor Manual (Excerpt)
Booth options: Standard inline booth (3m x 3m) — $1,200, includes one table and two chairs. Premium corner booth (6m x 3m) — $2,200, includes furniture and complimentary electrical service. Standard booths may add electrical service for $150. All freight must arrive at the official warehouse between March 2 and March 6. Shipments arriving after March 6 cannot be accepted at the warehouse and must be delivered directly to the venue on the designated move-in day for a $90 handling fee. Early move-in is available to corner booth exhibitors only.

--- Passage 2 ---
Booth Application Form — Westport Trade Fair 2026
Company: Nova Kitchenware Ltd. | Contact: Daniel Reyes, Marketing Director
Booth type requested: Standard inline (3m x 3m)
Additional services: Electrical service — YES
Freight note: Our display crates will ship from our Busan factory and are expected to reach Westport on March 9.
Signature: Daniel Reyes | Date: January 22

--- Passage 3 ---
To: Daniel Reyes <d.reyes@novakitchen.com>
From: Hana Lindqvist, Logistics Coordinator, Westport Trade Fair
Subject: Your freight arrangements
Dear Mr. Reyes,
Thank you for the update on your shipment schedule. Because your crates will arrive after our warehouse receiving window closes, they will need to be delivered directly to the exhibition hall on March 12, the designated move-in day for inline exhibitors. The applicable handling fee will be added to your final invoice. I can confirm that the electrical service you requested will be installed at your booth before move-in begins. Please have your driver check in at Gate C.
Best regards,
Hana Lindqvist

questions.question: What is the purpose of the first passage?
options: To advertise discounted booth rentals
To explain booth options and freight rules to exhibitors
To announce a change of venue for a trade fair
To recruit volunteers for an exhibition
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문은 박람회 출품업체 매뉴얼 발췌문으로, 부스 종류와 가격, 화물 입고 규정(창고 접수 기간, 직접 배송 수수료 등)을 안내하고 있습니다. 따라서 출품업체에게 부스 옵션과 화물 규정을 설명하는 것이 목적입니다. 할인 광고, 장소 변경 공지, 자원봉사자 모집과는 무관합니다.

questions.question: How much will Nova Kitchenware most likely pay for its booth and requested services, excluding freight fees?
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 지문 2의 신청서에서 Nova Kitchenware는 Standard inline 부스($1,200, 지문 1)와 전기 서비스(표준 부스는 $150 추가, 지문 1)를 신청했습니다. 따라서 $1,200 + $150 = $1,350입니다. 코너 부스 가격인 $2,200과 혼동하지 않도록 주의해야 합니다.

questions.question: Why will Nova Kitchenware be charged a $90 fee?
options: Its booth application was submitted after the deadline
It requested early move-in reserved for corner booths
Its shipment will arrive after the warehouse receiving window
It asked for additional furniture at the venue
questions.explanation: 세 지문을 모두 연계해야 하는 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 화물은 3월 2일~6일 사이에 창고에 도착해야 하며, 그 이후 도착분은 행사장 직접 배송과 $90 수수료가 부과된다고 했습니다. 지문 2에서 Nova의 화물은 3월 9일 도착 예정이고, 지문 3에서 창고 접수 기간이 지나 직접 배송으로 전환되며 수수료가 청구된다고 확인됩니다.

questions.question: According to the email, what is indicated about the electrical service?
options: It will be installed before move-in begins
It is no longer available for inline booths
It requires an additional application form
It is provided free of charge to all exhibitors
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 Lindqvist는 'the electrical service you requested will be installed at your booth before move-in begins'라고 확인해 주었습니다. 따라서 입주(move-in) 시작 전에 설치된다는 (A)가 정답입니다. 전기 서비스가 무료인 것은 코너 부스에만 해당합니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Nova Kitchenware's move-in?
options: It will take place on March 6
It is not eligible for early move-in
It must be rescheduled because of a venue conflict
It will be supervised by Mr. Reyes's factory staff
questions.explanation: 추론 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 조기 입주(early move-in)는 코너 부스 출품업체에만 허용된다고 했고, 지문 2에서 Nova는 Standard inline 부스를 신청했습니다. 따라서 Nova는 조기 입주 대상이 아니며, 지문 3에 따라 3월 12일 일반 입주일에 반입해야 합니다.

passage:
Aldergate Symphony Orchestra — 2026-27 Season Brochure (Excerpt)
Subscribe and save! Full Season package: all eight concerts at a 20% discount. Half Season package: any four concerts at a 10% discount. All subscribers enjoy free ticket exchanges up to 48 hours before any performance; non-subscribers pay a $15 exchange fee. Seating: Section A (orchestra level, $80 per concert), Section B (mezzanine, $60), Section C (balcony, $40). Upgrades between sections are permitted, subject to availability and payment of the price difference.

--- Passage 2 ---
Subscription Order Form — Aldergate Symphony Orchestra
Name: Mariko Tanaka | Package: Half Season (4 concerts)
Selected concerts: Sept 19 (Opening Gala), Nov 14, Feb 6, Apr 24
Seating: Section B, two seats (Row F, Seats 11-12)
Payment: Credit card ending 4482 | Confirmation no.: HS-30317

--- Passage 3 ---
To: boxoffice@aldergatesymphony.org
From: Mariko Tanaka <m.tanaka@plummail.net>
Subject: Seat change for November 14
Date: November 11
Hello,
I hold subscription HS-30317. A business trip has come up, so I cannot attend on November 14, and I would like to exchange both of my seats for the December 12 holiday concert instead. Since I am a subscriber, I understand no exchange fee should apply. Also, if orchestra-level seats are available on December 12, I would be happy to move down from the mezzanine and pay whatever difference is required for both tickets.
Thank you,
Mariko Tanaka

questions.question: In the brochure, what benefit is offered only to subscribers?
options: Complimentary parking at the concert hall
Free ticket exchanges before performances
Access to Section A seating
Invitations to meet the musicians
questions.explanation: 지문 1에서 구독자는 공연 48시간 전까지 무료 티켓 교환이 가능하지만, 비구독자는 $15의 교환 수수료를 내야 한다고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 구독자 전용 혜택은 무료 티켓 교환입니다. 주차, 단원과의 만남은 언급되지 않았고 Section A 좌석은 누구나 구매할 수 있습니다.

questions.question: What discount does Ms. Tanaka receive on her subscription?
questions.explanation: 이중 연계 문제입니다. 지문 2에서 Tanaka 씨는 Half Season(4개 공연) 패키지를 주문했고, 지문 1에서 Half Season 패키지는 10% 할인이 적용된다고 했습니다. 20%는 Full Season(8개 공연) 패키지의 할인율이므로 오답입니다.

questions.question: Why is Ms. Tanaka unlikely to be charged an exchange fee?
options: She requested the change more than 48 hours in advance
The November 14 concert was canceled by the orchestra
She is exchanging for a less expensive concert
The box office waives fees during the holiday season
questions.explanation: 연계 추론 문제입니다. 지문 1에 따르면 구독자는 공연 48시간 전까지 무료로 교환할 수 있습니다. 지문 3의 이메일 날짜는 11월 11일이고 공연은 11월 14일이므로 48시간 이상 전에 요청한 것입니다. 구독자 신분(지문 2의 확인번호 HS-30317)과 시점 조건을 모두 충족하므로 수수료가 부과되지 않습니다.

questions.question: If Ms. Tanaka's upgrade request is approved, how much extra will she most likely pay in total?
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 2에서 그녀는 Section B(공연당 $60) 좌석 2매를 보유하고 있고, 지문 3에서 orchestra level, 즉 Section A($80, 지문 1)로 두 좌석 모두 업그레이드를 원합니다. 좌석당 차액은 $80 - $60 = $20이며, 두 좌석이므로 $20 x 2 = $40입니다.

questions.question: In the e-mail, why does Ms. Tanaka want to exchange her tickets?
options: She was dissatisfied with her mezzanine seats
She has a scheduling conflict due to a business trip
She prefers to attend the Opening Gala instead
She found cheaper tickets through another vendor
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 'A business trip has come up, so I cannot attend on November 14'라고 명시하여 출장 때문에 11월 14일 공연에 참석할 수 없다고 밝혔습니다. 좌석 불만이나 가격 문제가 아니라 일정 충돌이 교환 사유입니다.

passage:
HiveWorks Co-Working — Day Passes (Webpage)
A HiveWorks day pass costs $25 and includes any open hot desk, high-speed Wi-Fi, and unlimited coffee. Passes are valid from 8:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M. Need quiet? Our third floor is a designated silent zone with phone booths nearby. Meeting rooms may be reserved separately for $15 per hour. Frequent visitor? Buy a bundle of ten passes for $200 — they never expire. Bundle holders may also reserve a specific desk one day in advance at no charge.

--- Passage 2 ---
HiveWorks Booking Confirmation
Member: Chidi Okafor | Purchase: 10-pass bundle (Order #B-7741)
First visit: Tuesday, June 3 | Check-in: 9:15 A.M.
Assigned area: Second floor, open collaboration area, Desk 2-18
Reminder: Present the QR code in this message at the front desk to redeem one pass per visit.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: support@hiveworks.com
From: Chidi Okafor <c.okafor@brightmail.io>
Subject: Noise in the open area
Hello,
I visited on June 3 using the first pass from my bundle (Order #B-7741). Unfortunately, a team near Desk 2-18 held a loud planning session for most of the morning, and I had difficulty concentrating on a report I was finalizing. I understand open areas can be lively, so I am not asking for a refund. However, for my visit this Friday, could you place me in the silent zone instead? Also, since I bought a bundle, I believe I can reserve a specific desk a day ahead — please confirm how to do that.
Thank you,
Chidi Okafor

questions.question: According to the webpage, what is included with a day pass?
options: One hour of meeting room use
Unlimited coffee
Overnight desk access
A reserved parking space
questions.explanation: 지문 1에서 데이 패스에는 핫데스크, 고속 Wi-Fi, 무제한 커피가 포함된다고 명시되어 있습니다. 회의실은 시간당 $15로 별도 예약해야 하고, 패스는 오전 8시~오후 8시까지만 유효하므로 야간 이용은 포함되지 않습니다.

questions.question: How much did Mr. Okafor effectively pay per visit?
questions.explanation: 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 2에서 Okafor 씨는 10회권 번들을 구매했고, 지문 1에서 번들 가격은 $200입니다. 따라서 1회당 $200 / 10 = $20입니다. $25는 단일 데이 패스 가격이므로 오답입니다.

questions.question: Where will Mr. Okafor most likely be seated on Friday if his request is granted?
options: In a second-floor phone booth
On the third floor
In a reserved meeting room
At Desk 2-18
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 지문 3에서 Okafor 씨는 금요일 방문 시 silent zone 배정을 요청했고, 지문 1에 따르면 silent zone은 3층에 있습니다. Desk 2-18은 소음 문제가 있었던 2층 개방형 구역의 자리이므로 오답입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Mr. Okafor's desk reservation request?
options: It requires a $15 fee per reservation
It is a benefit he is entitled to as a bundle holder
It must be made at least one week in advance
It was denied because of high demand
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 추론 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 번들 구매자는 하루 전에 특정 책상을 무료로 예약할 수 있다고 했고, 지문 2와 3에서 그가 번들(Order #B-7741) 구매자임이 확인됩니다. 따라서 그의 요청은 번들 보유자로서 정당하게 누릴 수 있는 혜택입니다. 수수료나 거절에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: In the e-mail, what does Mr. Okafor indicate about his June 3 visit?
options: He arrived after the valid pass hours
He was unable to finish his work without distraction
He requested a full refund for his bundle
He could not connect to the Wi-Fi network
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 그는 근처 팀의 시끄러운 회의 때문에 보고서 마무리 작업에 집중하기 어려웠다고('I had difficulty concentrating on a report I was finalizing') 말했습니다. 환불은 요청하지 않겠다고 명시했고, Wi-Fi나 입장 시간 문제는 언급되지 않았습니다.

passage:
Harborline Coffee Roasters — Wholesale Price List (Effective April 1)
House Blend: $12 per kilogram | Dark Roast: $14 per kilogram | Single-Origin Ethiopian: $18 per kilogram
Minimum wholesale order: 10 kilograms. Customers who set up a monthly standing order receive 5% off all listed prices. Delivery is free on orders over $200; otherwise a $20 delivery charge applies. To modify or pause a standing order, contact us at least ten days before your scheduled delivery.

--- Passage 2 ---
Harborline Coffee Roasters — Standing Order Agreement
Business: Café Lumen | Owner: Sofia Marchetti
Product: Single-Origin Ethiopian, 15 kg per month
Delivery schedule: First Monday of each month, before 9:00 A.M.
Start date: April 6 | Billing: Invoice on delivery, net 15 days

--- Passage 3 ---
To: s.marchetti@cafelumen.com
From: orders@harborlinecoffee.com
Subject: Important — June shipment substitution
Date: May 18
Dear Ms. Marchetti,
Due to a poor harvest, our Ethiopian beans will be unavailable for June deliveries. For your June 1 shipment, we can substitute our Single-Origin Colombian at the same per-kilogram price you currently pay, or we can pause your June delivery and resume in July, when we expect Ethiopian stock to return. If we do not hear from you by May 25, we will send the Colombian substitution automatically. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your continued business.
Sincerely,
Harborline Orders Team

questions.question: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To announce a price increase for all roasts
To inform a customer about a temporary product substitution
To request payment for an overdue invoice
To introduce a new delivery schedule
questions.explanation: 지문 3은 에티오피아 원두의 작황 부진으로 6월 배송분을 콜롬비아 원두로 대체하거나 배송을 한 달 쉬는 옵션을 안내하는 이메일입니다. 가격 인상, 연체 대금 청구, 새 배송 일정 도입과는 무관하며, 일시적 제품 대체를 알리는 것이 목적입니다.

questions.question: How much does Café Lumen most likely pay for its monthly order?
questions.explanation: 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 2에서 Café Lumen은 에티오피아 원두 15kg을 매월 주문하고, 지문 1에서 단가는 kg당 $18이며 정기 주문(standing order) 고객은 5% 할인을 받습니다. 15 x $18 = $270에서 5% 할인하면 $270 x 0.95 = $256.50입니다. $270은 할인 전 금액입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Café Lumen's delivery charges?
options: The café pays a $20 charge on every delivery
Delivery is free because the order total exceeds $200
Charges are waived only for Dark Roast orders
Delivery costs are split with the roaster
questions.explanation: 연계 추론 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 $200를 초과하는 주문은 무료 배송이라고 했고, Café Lumen의 월 주문액은 할인 적용 후에도 $256.50로 $200를 넘습니다. 따라서 배송비는 무료입니다.

questions.question: What will happen if Ms. Marchetti does not respond by May 25?
options: Her standing order will be canceled permanently
She will automatically receive Colombian beans in June
Her June delivery will be postponed to July
She will be charged a substitution fee
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 'If we do not hear from you by May 25, we will send the Colombian substitution automatically'라고 명시했습니다. 즉, 회신이 없으면 6월 배송분으로 콜롬비아 원두가 자동 발송됩니다. 주문 취소나 추가 수수료는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the Colombian substitution?
options: It will be priced at $14 per kilogram
It will be charged at the same rate as the Ethiopian beans
It requires a new standing order agreement
It is only available to new customers
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 콜롬비아 원두는 '현재 지불하는 것과 동일한 kg당 가격(at the same per-kilogram price you currently pay)'으로 제공된다고 했습니다. 즉, 에티오피아 원두와 같은 요율이 적용됩니다. $14는 Dark Roast 가격이므로 오답이며, 새 계약이 필요하다는 언급도 없습니다.

passage:
Calloway Group — Staff Training Portal Notice
All employees must complete the two mandatory compliance courses (Data Privacy Essentials and Workplace Safety Basics) by June 30. Upon completion, certificates are generated automatically within five business days and e-mailed to your company address. Please note: the name printed on a certificate is pulled directly from your HR profile. If your certificate shows an incorrect name, first verify your HR profile in the Employee Center; once the profile is correct, submit a Certificate Correction Form to the Learning & Development (L&D) team, who will reissue the document within three business days.

--- Passage 2 ---
Course Completion Record — Calloway Group Training Portal
Employee ID: 50912 | Course: Data Privacy Essentials
Completed: June 2 | Final score: 92% (Pass: 80% or above)
Certificate issued: June 4 | Name on certificate: Priya Ramen
Remaining mandatory course: Workplace Safety Basics — not started

--- Passage 3 ---
To: ld-team@callowaygroup.com
From: Priya Raman <p.raman@callowaygroup.com>
Subject: Certificate name correction
Date: June 5
Hello,
My certificate for Data Privacy Essentials spells my surname incorrectly. I checked the Employee Center as instructed and found that the error originates there, so I have already asked HR to update my profile; they confirmed the fix will be applied by June 8. I will submit the Certificate Correction Form as soon as HR confirms the change. Could you also tell me whether the reissued certificate will keep the original completion date? I want to make sure I am recorded as having finished before the June 30 deadline.
Thank you,
Priya Raman

questions.question: According to the notice, what should employees do first if their certificate shows a wrong name?
options: Retake the compliance course
Check their HR profile in the Employee Center
Call the L&D team directly
Print a new certificate from the portal
questions.explanation: 지문 1에서 증명서의 이름이 잘못된 경우 '먼저 Employee Center에서 HR 프로필을 확인'한 뒤, 프로필이 정정되면 Certificate Correction Form을 L&D 팀에 제출하라고 안내합니다. 따라서 첫 단계는 HR 프로필 확인입니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Raman's certificate show an incorrect name?
options: She entered her name incorrectly during the course exam
Her HR profile contains a spelling error
The portal merged her record with another employee's
The L&D team typed her name manually
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 증명서의 이름은 HR 프로필에서 자동으로 가져온다고 했고, 지문 2의 증명서에는 'Priya Ramen'으로 잘못 표기되어 있습니다. 지문 3에서 본인이 Employee Center를 확인한 결과 오류가 그곳(HR 프로필)에서 비롯되었다고 밝혔으므로, 원인은 HR 프로필의 철자 오류입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about Ms. Raman's course performance?
options: She scored above the passing threshold
She failed her first attempt at the course
She completed the course after the deadline
She has finished both mandatory courses
questions.explanation: 지문 2에서 그녀의 최종 점수는 92%이고 합격 기준은 80% 이상이므로 합격선을 넘었습니다. Workplace Safety Basics는 아직 시작하지 않았으므로 두 과정을 모두 끝냈다는 (D)는 오답이며, 완료일 6월 2일은 마감일 6월 30일 이전입니다.

questions.question: When will Ms. Raman most likely submit the Certificate Correction Form?
options: On June 2
On June 4
On or shortly after June 8
After June 30
questions.explanation: 연계 추론 문제입니다. 지문 3에서 HR이 6월 8일까지 프로필을 수정하겠다고 확인했고, 그녀는 'HR이 변경을 확인하는 대로' 양식을 제출하겠다고 했습니다. 지문 1의 절차상 프로필 정정이 선행되어야 하므로, 양식 제출 시점은 6월 8일 또는 그 직후가 됩니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Raman ask the L&D team about?
options: Whether the reissued certificate will keep the original completion date
Whether she can skip the Workplace Safety Basics course
Whether the deadline can be extended to July
Whether her exam score can be reviewed
questions.explanation: 지문 3의 마지막 부분에서 그녀는 재발급된 증명서가 원래 수료일을 유지하는지 문의하며, 6월 30일 마감 전에 수료한 것으로 기록되기를 원한다고 밝혔습니다. 과정 면제, 마감 연장, 점수 재검토는 요청하지 않았습니다.

passage:
CityWheel Bike Share — Corporate Plans (Webpage)
Team Plan: up to 25 registered riders, $300 per month. Each ride includes the first 45 minutes; additional time is billed at $0.15 per minute. E-bike rides carry a $1.00 unlock fee per ride.
Business Plan: up to 100 registered riders, $900 per month. Each ride includes the first 60 minutes, and all e-bike unlock fees are waived.
Both plans include monthly usage reports and a dedicated account manager. Plan changes take effect on the first day of the following month.

--- Passage 2 ---
CityWheel Monthly Usage Report — May
Account: Greenfield Consulting (Team Plan)
Registered riders: 22 | Total rides: 310 | Average ride length: 38 minutes
Rides exceeding included time: 14 (combined excess: 210 minutes)
E-bike unlocks: 30
Additional charges this month: $61.50 (see itemized invoice)

--- Passage 3 ---
To: accounts@citywheel.com
From: Lena Voss, Finance Manager, Greenfield Consulting
Subject: Question about May charges
Hello,
Our May invoice lists $61.50 in charges beyond our monthly plan fee, and I would like to confirm how this amount was calculated before approving payment. Also, our riders are using e-bikes more each month, and several employees have asked for longer ride allowances. Could you tell me whether moving to your larger plan would remove either of these extra costs? If the numbers make sense, we would like any change to start at the beginning of July.
Regards,
Lena Voss

questions.question: What is one feature included in both corporate plans?
options: Unlimited ride time
Monthly usage reports
Free e-bike unlock fees
Up to 100 registered riders
questions.explanation: 지문 1에서 두 플랜 모두 월간 사용 보고서와 전담 계정 관리자가 포함된다고 명시되어 있습니다. e-bike 잠금 해제 수수료 면제와 100명 등록은 Business Plan에만 해당하며, 무제한 이용 시간은 어느 플랜에도 없습니다.

questions.question: How was the $61.50 in additional charges most likely calculated?
options: 310 rides multiplied by a service fee
210 excess minutes at $0.15 plus 30 e-bike unlocks at $1.00
A late payment penalty added to the plan fee
22 riders multiplied by a registration charge
questions.explanation: 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 1의 Team Plan 요율에 따르면 초과 시간은 분당 $0.15, e-bike 잠금 해제는 회당 $1.00입니다. 지문 2에서 초과 시간 합계는 210분, e-bike 잠금 해제는 30회이므로 210 x $0.15 = $31.50, 30 x $1.00 = $30.00, 합계 $61.50입니다.

questions.question: If Greenfield Consulting upgrades to the Business Plan, which May charge would have been completely eliminated?
options: The monthly plan fee
The e-bike unlock fees
All excess-minute charges
The account manager fee
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 Business Plan은 e-bike 잠금 해제 수수료가 전액 면제되므로 지문 2의 $30 상당 수수료는 사라집니다. 반면 포함 시간은 60분으로 늘어날 뿐이므로 60분을 넘는 초과 요금 가능성은 남아 있어 '모든' 초과 요금이 없어진다고 단정할 수 없습니다. 월 기본료는 오히려 $900로 올라갑니다.

questions.question: In the e-mail, what does Ms. Voss ask the company to do?
options: Refund the May invoice in full
Explain how the additional charges were calculated
Register more riders under the current plan
Repair several damaged e-bikes
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 Voss 씨는 결제를 승인하기 전에 $61.50가 어떻게 산정되었는지 확인하고 싶다고 요청했습니다. 환불 요구나 라이더 추가 등록, 자전거 수리는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: According to the webpage, when would Greenfield's requested plan change take effect?
options: Immediately upon request
On July 1
At the end of the billing year
On the date the account manager approves it
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 플랜 변경은 다음 달 1일부터 적용된다고 했고, 지문 3에서 Voss 씨는 7월 초부터 변경을 원한다고 했습니다. 6월 중 요청하면 규정에 따라 7월 1일부터 적용되므로 그녀의 희망 시점과 일치합니다.

passage:
LinguaBridge Translation Services — Rate Card
Standard translation: $0.10 per word. Turnaround: five business days per 10,000 words.
Specialized content (legal, medical, technical): add $0.04 per word.
Rush service (half the standard turnaround): add 50% to the total.
Certified translation (signed accuracy statement): flat $35 per document.
All quotes are confirmed in writing before any work begins, and final files are delivered by secure download link along with an itemized invoice.

--- Passage 2 ---
Project Brief — LinguaBridge Order #TR-2284
Client: Meridian Legal Partners | Contact: Owen Castillo
Document: Supplier contract, 8,000 words (English to Spanish)
Content type: Legal | Certified translation required: Yes
Rush service: Not requested | Deadline: Friday, May 9
Assigned translator: Ines Duarte

--- Passage 3 ---
To: o.castillo@meridianlegal.com
From: i.duarte@linguabridge.com
Subject: Order #TR-2284 — request for two additional days
Dear Mr. Castillo,
I have completed about seventy percent of your contract translation. However, the document contains an unusually dense set of jurisdiction-specific terms, and verifying each one against current Spanish legal usage is taking longer than estimated. May I request an extension of the deadline to Sunday, May 11? To compensate for the inconvenience, LinguaBridge will apply a 10% discount to the total project fee. The certification statement will be included as planned. Please let me know by tomorrow afternoon whether the revised date works for you, as I would like to keep the remaining sections moving without interruption.
Sincerely,
Ines Duarte

questions.question: What was the original quoted price for Order #TR-2284?
questions.explanation: 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 2에서 8,000단어의 법률(legal) 문서이며 공증 번역이 필요합니다. 지문 1의 요율로 계산하면 단어당 $0.10 + 법률 할증 $0.04 = $0.14이므로 8,000 x $0.14 = $1,120이고, 공증 번역 $35를 더하면 총 $1,155입니다. $800은 표준 요율만 적용한 금액입니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Duarte request a deadline extension?
options: She received the source document late
Verifying specialized legal terminology is taking extra time
The client increased the word count of the contract
She was assigned to another urgent project
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 Duarte 씨는 관할권별 법률 용어가 매우 많아 각 용어를 현행 스페인어 법률 용례와 대조하는 작업이 예상보다 오래 걸린다고 설명했습니다. 문서 수령 지연, 분량 증가, 다른 프로젝트 배정은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: If Mr. Castillo accepts the offer in the e-mail, how much will his company most likely pay?
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 계산 문제입니다. 원래 견적은 $1,155(지문 1의 요율 + 지문 2의 사양)이고, 지문 3에서 마감 연장의 보상으로 총액에 10% 할인을 제안했습니다. $1,155 x 0.90 = $1,039.50입니다. $1,008은 공증료를 빼고 계산한 함정 답안입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the certification statement?
options: It will still be provided as originally planned
It will be omitted because of the delay
It requires an additional rush fee
It must be signed by Mr. Castillo
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 'The certification statement will be included as planned'라고 명시하여, 마감 연장과 무관하게 공증 진술서는 예정대로 포함된다고 확인했습니다. 생략되거나 추가 비용이 발생한다는 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: What is the proposed new deadline for the project?
options: Friday, May 9
Saturday, May 10
Sunday, May 11
Monday, May 12
questions.explanation: 지문 2의 원래 마감일은 5월 9일 금요일이고, 지문 3에서 Duarte 씨는 이틀 연장하여 5월 11일 일요일로 마감을 변경해 달라고 요청했습니다.

passage:
Skyline Terrace — Venue Rules for Private Events
Maximum rooftop capacity: 120 guests. All events must conclude by 10:00 P.M., and amplified music must end by 9:00 P.M. Open flames of any kind, including candles, are strictly prohibited under city fire code. In case of bad weather, the indoor Garden Lounge (capacity: 60 guests) may be added to a booking for an additional $400. Cancellations made within seven days of an event forfeit the full deposit.

--- Passage 2 ---
Event Proposal — Skyline Terrace
Organization: Halcyon Tech | Event: Summer Staff Party | Date: Friday, July 17
Expected attendance: 95 guests | Time: 5:00 P.M. - 9:30 P.M.
Entertainment: Live band, 6:00 P.M. - 9:00 P.M.
Decor plan: String lights and lit candles on all tables
Catering: External caterer (Verde Kitchen), buffet service

--- Passage 3 ---
To: events@halcyontech.com
From: m.ferraro@skylineterrace.com
Subject: July 17 — weather plan and decor note
Dear Halcyon Tech events team,
The extended forecast now shows a 70% chance of rain on July 17. We can add our indoor backup space to your booking at the standard supplement, but please be aware that it cannot accommodate your full guest list, so you may need to reduce attendance or split the group into two seatings. Separately, our review of your proposal flagged your table decor plan, which conflicts with our safety rules. Battery-powered LED candles are permitted and look quite similar — most clients are happy with them. Please confirm your decisions by July 10 so we can finalize arrangements.
Regards,
Marco Ferraro, Events Manager

questions.question: According to the venue rules, by what time must amplified music end?
questions.explanation: 지문 1에서 모든 행사는 오후 10시까지 종료해야 하고, 증폭 음악(amplified music)은 오후 9시까지 끝나야 한다고 명시되어 있습니다. 지문 2의 라이브 밴드가 9시에 끝나는 일정은 이 규정에 부합합니다.

questions.question: Why might the indoor backup space be a problem for Halcyon Tech?
options: It is unavailable on July 17
Its capacity is smaller than the expected attendance
It does not allow external caterers
It costs more than the rooftop rental
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 실내 Garden Lounge의 수용 인원은 60명인데, 지문 2에서 예상 참석자는 95명입니다. 지문 3에서도 전체 인원을 수용할 수 없어 인원 축소나 2회 분산이 필요할 수 있다고 안내합니다. 따라서 수용 인원 부족이 문제입니다.

questions.question: How much would adding the indoor space cost Halcyon Tech?
options: It would be free of charge
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 지문 3에서 Ferraro 씨는 'standard supplement(표준 추가 요금)'로 실내 공간을 추가할 수 있다고 했고, 지문 1에서 그 금액은 $400로 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.question: What part of Halcyon Tech's proposal conflicts with the venue's rules?
options: The use of an external caterer
The lit candles planned for the tables
The number of hours booked for the band
The 5:00 P.M. start time
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 양초를 포함한 모든 화기(open flames)는 소방 규정상 금지된다고 했는데, 지문 2의 장식 계획에는 테이블마다 불을 붙인 양초(lit candles)가 포함되어 있습니다. 지문 3에서도 장식 계획이 안전 규정과 충돌한다며 LED 양초를 제안합니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Ferraro ask the Halcyon Tech team to do?
options: Confirm their decisions by July 10
Pay their deposit within seven days
Change the event to a different venue
Hire a different catering company
questions.explanation: 지문 3의 마지막 문장에서 'Please confirm your decisions by July 10'이라고 요청했습니다. 보증금 납부, 장소 변경, 케이터링 업체 교체는 요청 사항이 아닙니다.

passage:
Fairhaven Airport Parking — Your Options (Webpage)
Economy Lot: $9 per day (drive-up rate: $12 per day). Free shuttle to all terminals every 20 minutes.
Covered Garage: $22 per day (drive-up rate: $28 per day). Direct walkway to Terminal 1.
Valet: $35 per day. Drop off at the departures curb.
Book online at least 24 hours ahead and save 15% on Economy and Garage rates. Important: reservations cover only the booked dates. Any additional days are billed at the drive-up daily rate for your chosen lot.

--- Passage 2 ---
Fairhaven Airport Parking — Reservation Confirmation
Name: Gordon Whitfield | Confirmation no.: PK-88410
Lot: Economy | Entry: April 3 | Exit: April 10 (7 days)
Rate: prepaid online, 15% discount applied | Total paid: $53.55
License plate: KTR-2049

--- Passage 3 ---
To: support@fairhavenparking.com
From: g.whitfield@centramail.com
Subject: Charge dispute — PK-88410
Hello,
My return flight on April 10 was canceled because of a storm, and the airline rebooked me for the next day, so I collected my car on April 11. I have now been billed an additional $12 for the extra day. I understand a charge applies, but I expected it to be the discounted daily rate I paid when booking, not a higher one. Since the delay was caused by the airline and not by me, I would appreciate it if you could adjust the charge or, at minimum, explain the basis for the amount.
Thank you,
Gordon Whitfield

questions.question: According to the webpage, what is an advantage of the Covered Garage?
options: It is the least expensive option
It offers a direct walkway to a terminal
It includes free car washing
Its shuttle runs every ten minutes
questions.explanation: 지문 1에서 Covered Garage는 Terminal 1까지 직접 연결되는 보행 통로(direct walkway)가 있다고 안내합니다. 가장 저렴한 옵션은 Economy Lot이고, 셔틀은 Economy Lot에서 20분 간격으로 운행되며, 세차 서비스는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What daily rate did Mr. Whitfield pay for his reserved dates?
questions.explanation: 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 2에서 그는 Economy Lot 7일을 온라인 선결제로 15% 할인받아 총 $53.55를 지불했습니다. 지문 1의 Economy 정가 $9에서 15% 할인하면 $9 x 0.85 = $7.65/일이고, 7일이면 $53.55로 결제 금액과 일치합니다.

questions.question: Why was Mr. Whitfield charged $12 for the extra day?
options: Online discounts expire after seven days
Additional days are billed at the drive-up rate
He was moved to the Covered Garage on April 11
A storm surcharge applied to all vehicles
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 예약은 예약한 날짜만 적용되며 추가 일수는 해당 주차장의 drive-up 일일 요금으로 청구된다고 명시했습니다. Economy Lot의 drive-up 요금은 $12이고, 지문 2의 예약은 4월 10일까지였는데 지문 3에서 4월 11일에 차를 찾았으므로 추가 1일이 $12로 청구된 것입니다.

questions.question: In the e-mail, why does Mr. Whitfield think the charge should be adjusted?
options: He left the lot before the exit time on his reservation
The delay was caused by his airline, not by him
He was promised a refund by a parking attendant
His confirmation listed the wrong license plate
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 그는 폭풍으로 항공편이 결항되어 항공사가 다음 날로 재예약한 것이므로, 지연의 원인이 본인이 아닌 항공사에 있다는 점을 들어 요금 조정을 요청했습니다. 조기 출차, 직원의 환불 약속, 번호판 오류는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: On what date did Mr. Whitfield actually pick up his car?
options: April 3
April 10
April 11
April 12
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 4월 10일 항공편이 결항되어 다음 날로 재예약되었고, 'I collected my car on April 11'이라고 명시했습니다. 4월 10일은 원래 예약상의 출차 예정일입니다.

passage:
BrightHome Appliances — Trade-In Program (Webpage)
Trade in your old refrigerator or washing machine and get rewarded! Eligible items must be less than ten years old and in working condition. After a free in-store or photo-based assessment, choose your payout: BrightHome store credit for the full assessed value, or a bank transfer for 85% of the assessed value. Home pickup of your old appliance is free when you purchase a new appliance from us; otherwise, a $25 pickup fee applies, deducted from your payout.

--- Passage 2 ---
BrightHome Trade-In Assessment Form
Customer: Eleanor Beck | Reference: TI-5527
Item: Front-load washing machine, 6 years old | Condition: Fully functional, minor cosmetic scratches
Assessed value: $130 | Payout method selected: Bank transfer
New appliance purchase: No | Home pickup requested: Yes, May 14

--- Passage 3 ---
To: e.beck@quartzmail.com
From: tradein@brighthome.com
Subject: Trade-in TI-5527 — payout processed
Dear Ms. Beck,
Your old washing machine was collected on May 14, and your payout has been processed today. A deposit of $85.50 will appear in your account within three business days. As a reminder, this figure reflects your selected payout method as well as the collection service you requested. If you would like a detailed breakdown, simply reply to this message. We hope to serve you again — and remember, trade-in customers receive an extra 5% off any new appliance purchased within 90 days.
Sincerely,
BrightHome Trade-In Team

questions.question: According to the webpage, which item would NOT be eligible for the trade-in program?
options: A twelve-year-old refrigerator in working condition
A five-year-old washing machine with scratches
A two-year-old refrigerator that runs normally
An eight-year-old washing machine in working order
questions.explanation: NOT 유형 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 보상 판매 대상은 10년 미만이고 작동 상태여야 합니다. 12년 된 냉장고는 작동하더라도 연식 기준(10년 미만)을 초과하므로 대상이 아닙니다. 나머지는 모두 10년 미만이며 작동 조건을 충족합니다.

questions.question: Why did Ms. Beck receive $85.50 instead of the full assessed value?
options: Her washing machine failed a second inspection
She chose a bank transfer and paid a pickup fee
She missed the scheduled collection appointment
Store credit was applied to a previous balance
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 2에서 평가액은 $130이고 은행 이체를 선택했으며 새 제품 구매 없이 방문 수거를 요청했습니다. 지문 1에 따르면 은행 이체는 평가액의 85%($130 x 0.85 = $110.50)이고, 새 제품 구매가 없는 수거에는 $25 수수료가 공제됩니다. $110.50 - $25 = $85.50로 지문 3의 입금액과 일치합니다.

questions.question: How could Ms. Beck have received the full $130 value?
options: By choosing store credit as her payout
By delivering the appliance in person
By submitting photos instead of an in-store assessment
By trading in a refrigerator instead
questions.explanation: 연계 추론 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 매장 적립금(store credit)을 선택하면 평가액 전액을 받을 수 있다고 했습니다. 다만 새 제품을 구매하지 않은 채 방문 수거를 요청하면 $25 수수료는 여전히 공제되므로, 전액 $130을 그대로 받으려면 적립금 선택이 핵심 조건입니다. 평가 방식(사진/매장)은 지급액과 무관합니다.

questions.question: In the e-mail, what is Ms. Beck invited to do if she wants more details?
options: Visit the nearest BrightHome store
Reply to the message
Call the trade-in hotline
Log in to her online account
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 'If you would like a detailed breakdown, simply reply to this message'라고 안내했습니다. 즉, 상세 내역을 원하면 이메일에 회신하면 됩니다. 매장 방문, 전화, 온라인 계정 로그인은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What additional benefit is mentioned in the e-mail?
options: A free extended warranty on any appliance
A 5% discount on a new appliance bought within 90 days
Double store credit during the summer sale
Free installation of a replacement washer
questions.explanation: 지문 3의 마지막 부분에서 보상 판매 고객은 90일 이내에 새 가전을 구매하면 추가 5% 할인을 받는다고 안내했습니다. 무상 보증 연장, 적립금 2배, 무료 설치는 언급되지 않았습니다.
